sources.title: Mechanics of Materials (Roylance), 2.1: Trusses
sources.boundary: Uses the public mechanics relation delta = P L / (A E) and equilibrium/compatibility reasoning only. The benchmark parameters and numeric targets are independently recomputed in this repository.

sources.title: Computing fundamental natural frequency of vibration of beams
sources.boundary: Uses the public Euler-Bernoulli cantilever reference formulas delta_tip = P L^3 / (3 E I) and delta_tip = w L^4 / (8 E I). The benchmark adds independently recomputed reactions, rotations and bending stresses.

sources.title: VM-WB-MECH-002: Rectangular Plate with Circular Hole Subjected to Tensile Loading
sources.boundary: Uses only the publicly displayed geometry, material, loading and target maximum normal X stress. Vendor project files, figures and the vendor-specific adaptive-mesh recipe are not copied into the benchmark.

sources.title: VM184: Straight Cantilever Beam
sources.boundary: Uses only the publicly displayed beam dimensions, material, three independent unit-load cases and theoretical target deflections. Ansys element names and input listings are outside the benchmark answer contract.
